parole.significato: a small, cramped room or apartment; a cubbyhole
parole.testo: Ultimately from Proto-Slavic *klětъka, perhaps via Ukrainian клітка (klitka). Doublet of klatka (“cage”).

parole.significato: heat, oestrus (state of a female animal that is ready for mating)
parole.testo: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *řuja. The late attestation of the word in Polish may indicate borrowing, most likely from Ukrainian руя (ruja). Compare Czech říje.

parole.significato: riffle (swift, shallow part of a stream)
parole.testo: Derived from Proto-Slavic *šьpъtъ, likely via dialectal Ukrainian ши́піт (šýpit). Doublet of szept.
